notes.title: Update - carry more than 1 weapon per level
notes.content:
To fulfill a user request, I create a new update that allow the player to carry more than one weapon per level.
After each 5 levels completed, one weapon will be unlocked.

notes.title: (update) New levels and achievement
notes.content:
Now the game has more levels, and a new achievement is created. 
The game has a total of 15 levels now. More levels are coming soon.
